findings.evidence: Lines 273-281, 289-297, 305-313, 321-329 are the same script modulo swapping `hq`/`hq'` and `Or.inl`/`Or.inr`; `Finset.insert_inter_of_mem` (Mathlib/Data/Finset/Lattice/Lemmas.lean:120), `Finset.singleton_inter_of_notMem` (:156), `Finset.insert_sdiff_of_mem` (Mathlib/Data/Finset/SDiff.lean:177), `Finset.pair_comm` (Mathlib/Data/Finset/Insert.lean:419).
findings.fix: Factor one pair-level lemma each, e.g. `private lemma pair_inter_eq (hne : a ≠ b) (ha : a ∈ V) (hb : b ∉ V) : ({a,b} : Finset α) ∩ V = {a}` and the `\` analogue (both are `Finset.insert_inter_of_mem`/`Finset.singleton_inter_of_notMem` and `Finset.insert_sdiff_of_mem` in two steps), then instantiate the four theorems with `Species.flavorPair` and `Finset.pair_comm`.

findings.evidence: `Finset.image_inter` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Finset/Image.lean:480) and `Finset.image_sdiff` (:504) both take exactly an injectivity hypothesis; `Species.conj_involutive.injective` is already used at lines 384, 392, 401, 410.
findings.fix: Prove `(C.valence h).image Species.conj = C.valence (C.conj h)` (from `C.mem_valence_conj` and `Species.conj_involutive`) and `(Species.flavorPair i).image Species.conj = Species.flavorPair i` once, then obtain both private lemmas from `Finset.image_inter _ _ Species.conj_involutive.injective` and `Finset.image_sdiff _ _ Species.conj_involutive.injective`.
findings.issue: `image_conj_inter_valence` (342) and `image_conj_sdiff_valence` (352) have identical proof scripts (only `Finset.mem_inter` vs `Finset.mem_sdiff`) and re-prove by hand that an injective image distributes over `∩` and `\`, hiding the two facts actually at work.

findings.evidence: Lines 459-466 and 473-480 differ only in which membership transport is supplied (`by simpa [C.mem_valence_conj] using hs` vs `(hv h s).2 hs`).
findings.fix: State it once, e.g. `theorem valenceStepFrag_apply_of_mem_valence_iff (σ : Species Flavor → Species Flavor) (hv : ∀ h s, σ s ∈ C.valence (τ h) ↔ s ∈ C.valence h) (h s z Q2) : valenceStepFrag C (τ h) (σ s) z Q2 = valenceStepFrag C h s z Q2`, then derive the charge-conjugation case with `σ := Species.conj` (its `hv` is `C.mem_valence_conj` at `Species.conj s` plus `Species.conj_conj`) and the flavour case with `σ := Species.map ρ`.
findings.issue: `chargeConjRelation_valenceStepFrag` (457) and `flavorRelation_valenceStepFrag` (470) duplicate the same `by_cases hz` / `by_cases hs` / four-`rw` case analysis; the reusable fact — that any pair of maps preserving the valence content preserves `valenceStepFrag` — is left implicit.

summary: Proofs are short, free of change/show and of undocumented defeq, but three blocks of substantial reasoning are copy-pasted instead of factored, hiding reusable Finset-level facts.
